points.K3: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
points.K5: 查着装：闭趾鞋、无首饰、扎头发
points.K7: 查设备：检测合格、状态良好
points.K8: 通风柜和生物安全柜不一样
points.K9: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去
points.K11: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
points.K14: 应急设施定期检查挂牌
points.K15: 熟悉疏散预案，出口通畅
points.K16: 查化学品：有标签、放整齐
points.K18: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通
points.K21: 实验后清洁台面和设备
points.K23: 清单只是起点，动手去查

shots.scene: 欣欣穿实验服站在实验室里，对镜微笑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a lab coat stands in the lab and smiles at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，示范一次实验室安全巡查。
overlay: 安全巡查：找找隐患在哪里

shots.scene: 小研拿着写字板走到实验台前，低头查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks up to a lab bench holding a clipboard and looks down carefully.
shots.narration: 今天由小研拿着清单来巡查。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手在空白清单上书写
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand writes on a blank checklist on a clipboard. No faces.
shots.narration: 大家跟着她，看看要查哪些地方。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，身旁出现放大镜和扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera beside a magnifying glass icon and a wrench icon.
shots.narration: 安全巡查，是主动发现隐患的工具。
overlay: 安全巡查：主动找隐患

shots.scene: 隐患图标旁出现扳手和对勾
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon next to a wrench icon and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 也用来确定需要采取的整改措施。

shots.section_title: 定期巡查是安全管理的一部分
shots.scene: 日历上每隔一段画一个勾，旁边一座办公楼图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with check marks at regular intervals next to an office building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定期巡查，是单位职业健康安全的重要部分。
overlay: 定期巡查是安全管理的一部分

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 王老师把空白清单发给学生
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands out clipboards with blank checklists to students.
shots.narration: 你们会拿到巡查清单来练习。
overlay: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera.
shots.narration: 老师可能偷偷藏了隐患，要看仔细。

shots.section_title: 拿好清单，留心隐蔽隐患
shots.scene: 清单上五个空白方框
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with five empty boxes and five small icons: goggles, a fume hood, an eyewash station, a reagent bottle and a broom. No people.
shots.narration: 我们一起去实验室看看。

shots.scene: 空无一人的实验室全景
shots.prompt_en: A wide shot of an empty teaching lab with clean benches. No people.
shots.narration: 第一项，个人防护用品。
overlay: 查PPE：实验服、眼镜、手套

shots.scene: 小研身上三处出现指示箭头：实验服、安全眼镜、手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a bench with three pointer arrows toward her lab coat, safety glasses and gloves.
shots.narration: 小研穿实验服、戴安全眼镜和手套。

shots.scene: 小研在清单上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks a box on her checklist.
shots.narration: 一般实验工作，这三样总是必需的。

shots.section_title: 查着装：闭趾鞋、无首饰、扎头发
shots.scene: 小研的鞋、手腕两处放大
shots.prompt_en: Two zoomed circles on the female graduate student: closed-toe shoes and bare wrists with no jewelry.
shots.narration: 她穿着闭趾鞋，没戴首饰。
overlay: 查着装：闭趾鞋、无首饰、扎头发

shots.section_title: 查着装：闭趾鞋、无首饰、扎头发
shots.scene: 小研的后脑勺，头发扎起
shots.prompt_en: The back of the female graduate student's head, her long hair neatly tied back.
shots.narration: 长头发也扎起来了。

shots.scene: 小研戴橙色耐热手套拧开灭菌锅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing orange heat-resistant gloves, unscrews the lid of a benchtop autoclave.
shots.narration: 有些工作要专门的防护用品。
overlay: 特殊工作，特殊防护

shots.scene: 灭菌锅盖子打开，冒出热气
shots.prompt_en: The autoclave lid opens and steam rises out. No people.
shots.narration: 比如开灭菌锅，要戴耐热手套。

shots.section_title: 查设备：检测合格、状态良好
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，旁边清单框里前两项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera beside a checklist frame whose first item is checked and second highlighted.
shots.narration: 第二项，设备。
overlay: 查设备：检测合格、状态良好

shots.section_title: 查设备：检测合格、状态良好
shots.scene: 小研在台前操作仪器，仪器上挂着空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student operates an instrument at the bench; a blank inspection tag hangs on its side.
shots.narration: 所有设备都应检测认证，状态良好。

shots.section_title: 通风柜和生物安全柜不一样
shots.scene: 通风柜和生物安全柜并排，各有指示箭头
shots.prompt_en: A chemical fume hood and a biological safety cabinet standing side by side, each with a pointer arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 这两个柜子外观相似，功能完全不同。
overlay: 通风柜和生物安全柜不一样

shots.section_title: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作化学品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student handles a reagent bottle inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 操作有毒化学品时，通风柜保护你。
overlay: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去

shots.section_title: 通风柜：把有害蒸气排出去
shots.scene: 天花板上的排风管，箭头指向屋外
shots.prompt_en: A low-angle view of the exhaust duct on the ceiling, with arrows showing air flowing out of the building. No people.
shots.narration: 气流把蒸气带走，经管道排到室外。

shots.scene: 柜侧空白合格证标签特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank certificate label on the side of the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 这张认证标签，说明它检测合格。
overlay: 看合格标签

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜内用移液器操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a pipette with tubes inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜用于操作感染性细菌。
overlay: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
shots.scene: 生物安全柜内气流经过滤器的示意
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with arrows showing air passing through a filter layer and flowing down over the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 空气经高效过滤，形成洁净工作区。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
shots.scene: 人和样品管各有一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram and a sample tube icon, each protected by a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 既保护你，也保护样品不被污染。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：过滤空气，人和样品都保护
shots.scene: 生物安全柜的空白合格证和控制面板
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate label next to the control panel of the biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 它同样要有检测认证标签。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，清单框第三项高亮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera beside a checklist frame with the third item highlighted.
shots.narration: 第三项，应急设施。
overlay: 查应急设施：知道在哪

shots.scene: 水槽上的洗眼器、墙边的冲淋器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station on a lab sink and a yellow safety shower by the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 知道冲淋器和洗眼器在哪里。

shots.scene: 灭火器箱和急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A red fire extinguisher cabinet and a first aid kit on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 还有灭火器和急救箱。

shots.scene: 小研快步走向冲淋器，路上没有阻挡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks quickly to the safety shower along a clear path.
shots.narration: 这些地方周围不能有障碍，
overlay: 应急设施前不堆东西

shots.scene: 通往洗眼器的绿色箭头
shots.prompt_en: A green arrow on the floor leading straight to the eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 这样才能最快到达。

shots.section_title: 应急设施定期检查挂牌
shots.scene: 冲淋器和标志特写，挂着空白检查吊牌
shots.prompt_en: A low-angle close-up of the safety shower and its sign, with a blank inspection tag hanging on the pull handle. No people.
shots.narration: 这些设施也要定期检查、挂好标签。
overlay: 应急设施定期检查挂牌

shots.section_title: 熟悉疏散预案，出口通畅
shots.scene: 空白疏散预案图和出口门
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation plan on the wall, then the camera pans to a clear exit door with an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉紧急疏散预案。
overlay: 熟悉疏散预案，出口通畅

shots.section_title: 熟悉疏散预案，出口通畅
shots.scene: 出口门前空空荡荡，出口标志亮着
shots.prompt_en: The area in front of the exit door is clear and the emergency exit sign is lit. No people.
shots.narration: 出口要通畅，并有标志。

shots.section_title: 查化学品：有标签、放整齐
shots.scene: 木柜里整齐摆放的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles with blank labels lined up neatly in a wooden cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 第四项：化学品都要贴标签、放整齐。
overlay: 查化学品：有标签、放整齐

shots.scene: 一瓶试剂的空白标签特写，带象形图
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a reagent bottle label with blank text and a red diamond GHS pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 标签有性质、生产商、危害等信息，
overlay: 标签和SDS里的安全信息

shots.scene: 标签旁浮现护目镜和柜子图标
shots.prompt_en: Goggles and storage cabinet icons appear beside the label. No people.
shots.narration: 还有防护用品和储存要求。

shots.scene: 手打开空白文件夹，翻到一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: A hand opens a blank binder and turns to a blank safety data sheet page. No faces.
shots.narration: 更详细的信息，查SDS。

shots.section_title: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜，清单框五项都已出现
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera beside a checklist frame with the fifth item highlighted.
shots.narration: 最后一项，内务。
overlay: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通

shots.section_title: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通
shots.scene: 小研给仪器罩上塑料罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers an instrument with a plastic dust cover.
shots.narration: 自己用过的东西，自己收拾好。

shots.section_title: 查内务：随手清理，通道畅通
shots.scene: 小研把椅子推进台下，通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pushes a chair under the bench, leaving the aisle clear.
shots.narration: 实验室整齐无杂物，通道没有障碍。

shots.scene: 实验室冰箱
shots.prompt_en: A lab refrigerator with sample racks inside. No people.
shots.narration: 不要把食物和饮料带进实验室。
overlay: 饮食不进实验室

shots.scene: 小研从冰箱里取出一瓶黄色液体，瓶上贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a bottle of yellow liquid with a blank handwritten label out of the refrigerator.
shots.narration: 实验用的食品，要标明仅供实验使用。

shots.scene: 台面上铺开带生物危害标志的红色废物袋
shots.prompt_en: A red waste bag with a biohazard warning sign is opened on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物，放进有生物危害标志的容器。
overlay: 生物废物进专用容器

shots.section_title: 实验后清洁台面和设备
shots.scene: 小研喷洒消毒液擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays disinfectant on the bench and wipes it with paper towels, wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 每次实验后，清洁设备和实验台。
overlay: 实验后清洁台面和设备

shots.scene: 红色玻璃专用容器旁放着锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A red container with a blank label for glass only, next to an Erlenmeyer flask. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃这类锐器，
overlay: 锐器进防刺穿容器

shots.scene: 碎玻璃放进贴着生物危害标签的红色锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass is placed into a red sharps container with a biohazard warning sign and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 放进可封口的防刺穿容器。

shots.section_title: 清单只是起点，动手去查
shots.scene: 小研在清单上书写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on her checklist.
shots.narration: 这些只是巡查清单里的一部分。
overlay: 清单只是起点，动手去查

shots.section_title: 清单只是起点，动手去查
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜微笑，指向实验室
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot smiles at the camera and points toward the lab.
shots.narration: 现在，去实验室开始你的巡查吧。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五项清单图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five floating icons: goggles, a fume hood, an eyewash station, a reagent bottle and a broom.
shots.narration: 防护、设备、应急、化学品、内务。
overlay: 小结

shots.scene: 两个柜子和合格标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood and a biological safety cabinet, each with a blank certificate label. No people.
shots.narration: 两种柜子功能不同，都要有合格标签。

shots.scene: 应急设施、试剂柜、锐器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clear eyewash station, a neat reagent cabinet and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 设施不堵，试剂贴签，锐器入盒。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写满勾的清单挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a clipboard full of green check marks and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 学会巡查，实验室更安全！
